techs.name: Mycelia Tether
techs.notes: +1 Shared orb per node. Places nodes (max 3; Boost adds 2 extra tether lines) plus tether lines; 1 hit + 3 spore ticks of 0.3 DoT. 15% damage share. A tether snapped by damage blooms into an HP refund. Shaves nothing while building. +40% in U3 sunlight; -50% in U2 and U6 dimness.

techs.name: Photosynthetic Burst
techs.notes: Bible alias mycelia_bloom. 1 hit + 3 ticks of 0.3 DoT. 0.6 s hold, then the burst consumes Spore Tags and Sunlight Stacks; each refunds 4% HP and 2 MP to every tethered ally. Rooted while casting: +70% damage reduction. Germinates snapped nodes into seedlings. Dim maps halve the conversion.

techs.name: Dew Lance
techs.notes: The party's [WATER]. Puts out oil fires.

techs.name: Core Lattice
techs.notes: Target: Crono in his galaxy state. His ASTRAL costs halve and his DEF +30% for 3 of his turns.

techs.name: Divinity Field
techs.notes: Whole arena. Allies gain +1 temporary plate per 5 s (cap 20% of max HP as temporary shield); thaws Ruin 1% per 8 s; an enemy that Breaks inside it is silenced 15 s. Counters Vaelos's Gravity.

techs.name: Reptite Crown
techs.notes: Relic ultimate. 6 petals + crown, 3.3 total. Grows a permanent blooming canopy: +1 Sunlight Stack every 5 s for the rest of the battle. +50% if the Lavos moon is visible (U3).
